scope: Post-run developer visual check of the four previously observed categories. It checks visible door arcs/walls and coarse placement only. It is not GT acceptance, human approval, a complete drawing-fidelity assessment, or input to any generator.
coordinate_note: Pixel boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] in the original plan PNG and bound visible cyan door-leaf/arc ink or the continuous-wall area. They are not calibrated doorway endpoints.

overall.qualitative_result: The prior severe room-side, extra-door, and false-door errors are absent from the final opening inventory. Remaining items are dimensional/provenance limits, not a newly observed missing or extra internal door.
overall.source_geometry_note: The candidate report records a self-consistent, viewable source geometry. This review does not turn that result into an original-drawing fidelity claim.

categories.name: north_south_partition_assignment
categories.candidate_evidence: F1 rooms N1/N2/N3 occupy y=5..8 and S1/S2/S3 occupy y=0..3. The retained north/south window and entrance records use the matching facades after the y reflection.
categories.drawing_evidence: North and South elevations respectively show the office-row and entrance/lounge-row patterns used by the correction. The F1 candidate plan places their door rows on the corresponding high-y and low-y sides.
categories.uncertainty: This is a coarse orientation and room-row check. It does not remeasure every elevation opening.

categories.name: f1_second_partition_false_doors

Single upper arc/leaf on the N3 side.
S2-side horizontal wall at the second lower partition is continuous; no jamb, gap, or swing arc.

categories.name: f2_office_duplicate_or_wrong_connections
categories.candidate_evidence: The final inventory contains exactly four office doors: O1-to-corridor (legacy ID D_F2_O1_O2), O2-to-corridor, O3-to-corridor, and O4-to-corridor (legacy ID D_F2_O3_O4). D_F2_O1_C and D_F2_O4_C are absent. No final office door has another office as other_space_id.

drawing_evidence.meaning: O1 leaf at the O1/O2 seam, facing the corridor.
O2 leaf at the same seam, facing the corridor.
O3 leaf at the O3/O4 seam, facing the corridor.
O4 leaf at the same seam, facing the corridor.

categories.uncertainty: No F2 candidate-plan PNG was saved for this run, so this checks the final proposal relationships and the original plan, rather than a second rendered F2 plan. The exact four door spans are still modeled approximations.

categories.name: f1_small_south_window
categories.candidate_evidence: W_F1_S1 is on the South facade near the entrance at span 3.44..4.64 and z 1.5..2.1, replacing the old placeholder position. Its object assumptions continue to say exact width and sill are inferred.
categories.drawing_evidence: South_view.png shows the small cyan window adjacent to the ground-floor entrance. The correction audit cites the bottom dimension chain and cyan outline at original pixels approximately [511,470,580,500].
categories.uncertainty: The retained object source text labels the size as assumed. This review supports coarse placement beside the entrance, not a precise sill, head, or width certification.

The paired central door arcs are present; their spans remain seed estimates and are explicitly unresolved.

provenance_review.audit_limit: The new helper propagates source_refs for subsequent update operations only. It does not retroactively rewrite active source text for run03/run04 updates. Therefore the complete audit preserves old before records and some active legacy wording; this review does not claim that all historic text has been cleaned.

limitations: An earlier quick review mistakenly counted left-side doors at the second F1 vertical partition. Enlarged inspection of the original pixels corrected that mistake; this record uses only the corrected single-arc conclusion.

Door arcs and continuous walls support existence, coarse side, and coarse room relationship only. They do not certify all dimensions, hinge state, construction, source-BIM completeness, or original-drawing fidelity.
